title.value: FedShuffle: Recipes for Better Use of Local Work in Federated Learning
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: FedShuffle: Recipes for Better Use of Local Work in Federated Learning

extractions.description: The paper introduces FedShuffle, a federated learning method designed to improve the use of local updates, especially in heterogeneous environments with data imbalance and random reshuffling. It provides theoretical convergence guarantees and demonstrates improvements over existing methods like FedAvg and FedNova. The method adjusts local step sizes and aggregation steps to address objective inconsistency problems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of federated learning algorithms. While the improved algorithms could potentially be applied to sustainable development-related tasks, the core focus is on the algorithm itself rather than a direct application to sustainable development.
